method: Web search and direct fetch of manufacturer/dealer listing pages for new self-propelled motorhomes and campervans from makes not already in the catalog. Only models with a car-licence-qualifying gross weight as stated on the source page were kept (US GVWR under 26,000 lb; GB MTPLM at or under 3,500 kg). Prices are the exact figures shown on the cited page on 2026-10-05; nothing was estimated or converted except where noted. Several candidate makes (Scotweb-equivalent search misses aside) were dropped when no page could be found stating both a readable price and a qualifying gross weight: Vantage, Lunar, Elnagh, Etrusco, Campereve, Outside Van, Contravans, Pössl (no GB/IE-currency price page found), Remote Vans. Sportsmobile dropped 2026-10-05: its $50,000 reads as the conversion alone, without the van it is built on.
